title: Spotted Owlet — ISO 10,000
subtitle: Two Spotted Owlets at the Bandhavgarh tiger reserve, shot at ISO 10,000 on an OM-1 micro four-thirds sensor. Fine feather detail and dark plumage stress noise reduction and sharpening simultaneously.

title: Hummingbird — Costa Rica
subtitle: A hummingbird feeding at a flower in Costa Rica, shot on the OM-1. Iridescent feathers, fine eye detail, and motion-blurred wing tips give noise-reduction and sharpening tools several distinct regions to handle differently.

title: Steller's Sea Eagle — ISO 800
subtitle: Steller's Sea Eagle photographed off Rausu, Hokkaido, at 1/1600s and ISO 800. Dark plumage against bright water and snow surfaces stresses noise reduction in distinct ways — uniform low-noise backgrounds vs. fine feather detail.

title: Bald Eagle — motion blurred
subtitle: Two bald eagles in mid-air confrontation. The original RAW is significantly motion-blurred from the eagle's wing motion combined with shutter speed. Tests Topaz Photo's two subject-sharpening modes — Focus Blur vs Motion Blur — for how well each recovers apparent sharpness on the bald eagle's head and wings.

title: Black-throated Trogon — ISO 12,800
subtitle: A black-throated trogon perched in rainforest in Costa Rica's Osa Peninsula, shot at ISO 12,800. Iridescent green plumage, a deep black throat, vivid yellow chest, and finely barred tail feathers give noise-reduction tools a demanding mix of saturated colour, fine detail, and graded tones to handle at very high ISO.

title: Burrowing Owl with moth
subtitle: A burrowing owl in low flight at Rocky Mountain Arsenal, Colorado, locked onto a moth in mid-air. Soft, uniform grass behind the bird sits alongside finely-detailed feather and face structure — giving noise-reduction tools both a smooth gradient region and a high-detail region to handle.
